safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes Clenil used daily/twice daily but does not specify baseline dose of 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs BID) reduces clarity about the patient’s usual controller regimen and makes it harder to judge the degree of step-up in inhaled steroid during an exacerbation. This could lead to suboptimal dosing decisions but is unlikely to directly cause major harm on its own.
